data.body:
[P2] Wait for native recovery completion before releasing the peer

This wait happens after `_deadline()` has already released and finished the healthy peer. `Cloud.finish(recovery)` waits for logical execution success and wrapper return, but does not require the original request's native completion. If that completion occurs after the released peer finishes, the new validator rejects the run even though the harness caused the capacity gap. Move the completion wait into `_deadline()`, before its final peer-liveness check and peer release. Add a regression where native recovery completion lags logical success and wrapper return.
